message.content: On April 3, 2026, Hailey Johnson's bakery is delivering bread to Li Hua. This information is confirmed by the delivery notification message from Alice, an employee at Hailey's bakery, who states, "I am Alice from Hailey's bakery. Your bread has been delivered, please come and pick it up ASAP. Have a good day : )" as documented in the conversation log with the timestamp "Time: 20260403_08:00" and the message ID "5".
